description: Engine-mechanics benchmark against the actual pinned v2 instruction corpus. Natural phrases are deliberately unchanged exact-equality probes; zero hits document the lack of semantic retrieval rather than a relevance pass.

unsupportedTextQueries.name: substring
unsupportedTextQueries.query: MATCH (n:Content) WHERE n.title CONTAINS $phrase RETURN n.title AS title

unsupportedTextQueries.name: case folding
unsupportedTextQueries.query: MATCH (n:Content) WHERE lower(n.title) = $phrase RETURN n.title AS title

unsupportedTextQueries.name: regular expression
unsupportedTextQueries.query: MATCH (n:Content) WHERE n.title =~ $phrase RETURN n.title AS title

unsupportedTextQueries.name: full text procedure
unsupportedTextQueries.query: CALL QUERY_FTS_INDEX($phrase) RETURN n.title AS title

unsupportedTextQueries.name: vector relevance
unsupportedTextQueries.query: MATCH (n:Content) WHERE vector_similarity(n.title, $phrase) > $score RETURN n.title AS title
